steps.title: Analyze compilation diagnostics
steps.description: Examine the compiler error logs to pinpoint wrong R resource identifier and layout selections as well as missing widget imports.

steps.title: Correct MainActivity layout resource reference
steps.description: Change setContentView target parameter from R.id.activity_main to R.layout.activity_main to load the visual XML tree layout successfully.

steps.title: Correct LoginActivity layout resource reference
steps.description: Fix the target reference in LoginActivity from R.id.activity_login to R.layout.activity_login to clear compile errors.

steps.title: Import LinearLayout in VaultActivity
steps.description: Include missing android.widget.LinearLayout import statement to allow programmatic custom layout creations during dialog inflation.

steps.title: Verify offline statistics calculations
steps.description: Ensure total items count calculation performs offline mathematical additions in real-time.

steps.title: Verify local storage fallback databases
steps.description: Validate local fallback reading/writing of notes and credentials through standard device-bound SharedPreferences.

steps.title: Confirm Shared Preferences keys for PIN storage
steps.description: Audit the decoy calculation sequence and comparison check logic matching the secret access pin.

steps.title: Audit network API parameters in BackendApi
steps.description: Correct assets reading block to correctly obtain the app_id property from app-meta.json configurations.

steps.title: Validate AndroidManifest properties
steps.description: Double check application package configurations and target components registry.

steps.title: Building Vault Launcher
steps.description: Run the Gradle compiler pipeline to generate and package the debug APK with no error diagnostics.
